summary: Duplicate Advisory: Quadratic CPU exhaustion in TreebankWordTokenizer.span_tokenize via list.pop(0) in quote-restore loop
details:
## Duplicate Advisory

This advisory has been withdrawn because it is a duplicate of GHSA-ffr9-mgrr-wcvr. This link is maintained to preserve external references.

## Original Description
NLTK from 3.2.5 before 3.10.4 contains an algorithmic complexity vulnerability in TreebankWordTokenizer.span_tokenize that allows remote attackers to cause quadratic CPU consumption through repeated list.pop(0) calls. Attackers can submit long runs of double-quote characters to services span-tokenizing untrusted text, exhausting a CPU core and degrading availability.
